title: Shipped-Conformance Manifest
description: JSON Schema for aims-proof/checker/shipped-conformance-manifest.json. Per the locality shipped-conformance gate SC3: defines the structural shape {rules: [{id, proof_artifact, unblock_condition, blocked_by, annotation_targets}]} with required-field constraints. Validated by aims-proof/scripts/run-section-08-proofs.sh --locality-section and the pre-commit hook so structural drift surfaces mechanically rather than via human review.

blocked_by.description: Cross-plan advisory pointer to the work that unblocks the manifest (typically locality-representation-unification).

id.description: Rule identifier per Annex E §AIMS (e.g., RL-15a, RL-18a, DP-7, DP-8, CN-6, CN-8, IC-3).

proof_artifact.description: Path to the proof artifact under aims-proof/proofs/ that discharged this rule against the 5-variant Locality target.

unblock_condition.description: Plain-prose statement of the shipped-code state that flips the rule from divergent-pending to pass.

blocked_by.description: Subsystem that owns the unblocking work (e.g., locality-representation-unification).

annotation_targets.description: Exact Annex E §AIMS anchor citations §12 SHALL clear when the rule flips divergent-pending -> pass.
